narrative: PBT is £7.4M behind budget year to date. NII is £4.8M short: rate cuts −£7.4M and funding cost −£2.3M, partly offset by volume +£3.6M and mix +£1.3M. Impairment is £5.4M over plan (development finance stage 2). Operating costs are £2.8M under budget, but that is phasing — £1.8M of IT change spend lands in Q4.

signals.title: NIM compression: NII £1.1M behind budget in September
signals.excerpt: Variable lending and BoE reserves repriced after the 2026 Bank Rate cuts; £2.35Bn of fixed-term bonds reprice only on maturity. NIM 3.80% YTD vs 3.99% budget.

signals.title: Development finance stage 2 up from 9.8% to 16.4%
signals.excerpt: Four South East & East schemes (£52M) moved to stage 2 in Q3; FY2026 cost of risk forecast 30 bps vs 15 bps plan.

signals.title: 9+3 forecast: PBT £83.2M vs £93.0M budget
signals.excerpt: Operating income £187.8M (−£6.5M), impairment £14.5M (+£7.2M), operating costs £88.1M (−£3.8M); CIR 46.9%.
